name: readme-ux-kit
description: A comprehensive toolkit for beautiful readme design.

scripts.check:app: python -m compileall -q src/app && node --check src/app/static/app.js && uv --no-cache run --project src python -m src.app --self-test
scripts.generate:all-data: uv --no-cache run --project src python -m src.modules.cli generate
scripts.check:generators: python -m compileall -q src/modules/generators && python src/modules/generators/generate_asset_previews.py --self-test && python src/modules/generators/generate_asset_manifest.py --self-test && python src/modules/generators/generate_editor_data.py --self-test && python src/modules/generators/generate_readme_svg.py --self-test && python src/modules/generators/normalize_svg_accessibility.py --self-test && python src/modules/generators/validate_svg_assets.py --self-test
scripts.check:modules: python -m compileall -q src/modules && npm run check:generators && python -m src.modules.editor.svg_editor --self-test && python -m src.modules.schemas.schema_registry --self-test && python -m src.modules.reports.quality_report --self-test && python -m src.modules.packagers.asset_packs --self-test && python -m src.modules.compatibility.github_markdown --self-test && python -m src.modules.migrations.migration_registry --self-test && python -m src.modules.analyzers.svg_analysis --self-test && python -m src.modules.indexers.search_index --self-test && python -m src.modules.indexers.component_index --self-test && python -m src.modules.indexers.template_index --self-test && python -m src.modules.markdown.markdown_quality --self-test && python -m src.modules.markdown.placeholder_quality --self-test && python -m src.modules.themes.theme_index --self-test && python -m src.modules.provenance.provenance_index --self-test && python -m src.modules.recipes.recipe_index --self-test && python -m src.modules.renderers.svg_smoke_render --self-test && python -m src.modules.renderers.svg_to_gif --self-test && python -m src.modules.site.site_checks --self-test && python -m src.modules.site.stage_pages --self-test && python -m src.modules.release.release_readiness --self-test && python -m src.modules.validators.check_quality --self-test && python -m src.modules.validators.design_system_quality --self-test && python -m src.modules.cli --self-test
scripts.modules:check: uv --no-cache run --project src python -m src.modules.cli check
scripts.modules:report: uv --no-cache run --project src python -m src.modules.cli report
scripts.check:all: npm run check:app && npm run check:modules && npm run check:svg && npm run check:svg:accessibility && npm run check:svg:optimize && npm run check:previews && npm run check:manifest && npm run check:site-data && npm run check:editor && npm run check:analysis && npm run check:indexes && npm run check:components && npm run check:templates && npm run check:markdown && npm run check:placeholders && npm run check:themes && npm run check:provenance && npm run check:recipes && npm run check:render-smoke && npm run check:compatibility && npm run check:packs && npm run check:reports && npm run check:migrations && npm run check:schemas && npm run check:site && npm run check:pages && npm run check:quality && npm run check:design-system && npm run check:release-readiness
